name: Lighter Note Los Feliz Poached Lobster Salad (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Poached cold-water lobster medallions are pure, zero-fiber lean protein when separated from the citrus vinaigrette and raw greens.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to plate the poached lobster tail medallions warm over mashed potatoes or steamed rice with drawn butter (no salad greens, no citrus dressing).
watchOuts: Citrus dressing on standard salad build (strict avoid)
